metadata.question: Does Dorsoidong Co Lake have a lighter blue color than Chibzhang Co Lake in October 12, 1987?

data.raw_code: The question is about comparing the color (blue intensity) of two lakes on a specific date. This requires: 1. Finding satellite imagery from October 12, 1987 2. Identifying both lakes (Dorsoidong Co and Chibzhang Co) in Tibet 3. Comparing the blue reflectance values For 1987, Landsat 5 would be the appropriate satellite (Landsat 5 launched in 1984). I need to: - Get Landsat 5 surface reflectance data - Focus on the blue band (Band 1 for Landsat 5) - Create geometries around both lakes - Calculate mean blue reflectance for each lake - Compare the values The lakes are in Tibet, so I'll create point geometries near their locations based on known coordinates. I need to handle: - Checking if images exist for that specific date - Cloud masking - Valid pixel counts - Comparison logic If no data exists for that exact date, I'll try a small date range around it. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const dorsoidongCo = ee.Geometry.Point([82.5, 32.0]); // Approximate location of Dorsoidong Co const chibzhangCo = ee.Geometry.Point([82.8, 32.2]); // Approximate location of Chibzhang Co const date = '1987-10-12'; const bufferDays = 5; // Buffer for date search // 2. Data Acquisition - Landsat 5 for 1987 const landsatCol = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate('1987-10-07', '1987-10-17') // ±5 days buffer .filterBounds(ee.Geometry.MultiPoint([dorsoidongCo, chibzhangCo])); const colSize = landsatCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 5 images in date range: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("No Landsat 5 images found for date range."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Get closest image to target date const targetDate = ee.Date(date); const sortedCol = landsatCol.sort('system:time_start', false); const image = ee.Image(sortedCol.first()); // 3. Processing - Extract blue band (SR_B1 for Landsat 5) const blueBand = 'SR_B1'; // Define regions around lakes (5km buffers) const dorsoidongRegion = dorsoidongCo.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer const chibzhangRegion = chibzhangCo.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer // Calculate mean blue reflectance for each lake const dorsoidongStats = image.select(blueBand).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: dorsoidongRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const chibzhangStats = image.select(blueBand).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: chibzhangRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const dorsoidongBlue = dorsoidongStats.get(blueBand).getInfo(); const chibzhangBlue = chibzhangStats.get(blueBand).getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels const dorsoidongCount = image.select(blueBand).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: dorsoidongRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(blueBand).getInfo(); const chibzhangCount = image.select(blueBand).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: chibzhangRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(blueBand).getInfo(); console.log(`Dorsoidong Co - Blue: ${dorsoidongBlue?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${dorsoidongCount}`); console.log(`Chibzhang Co - Blue: ${chibzhangBlue?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${chibzhangCount}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (dorsoidongCount === 0 || chibzhangCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels in one or both regions."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (dorsoidongBlue === null || chibzhangBlue === null || isNaN(dorsoidongBlue) || isNaN(chibzhangBlue)) { console.log("Invalid reflectance values."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare blue reflectance (higher value = lighter/lighter blue) const dorsoidongLighter = dorsoidongBlue > chibzhangBlue; console.log(`Comparison: Dorsoidong Co ${dorsoidongLighter ? 'lighter' : 'darker'} than Chibzhang Co`); if (dorsoidongLighter) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
